transcript.text: Good morning, everyone. I wanted to get us together to talk about T-14. As we all know, the solvent storage tank T-14 has been isolated from production for several months now, and it's sitting in the expansion bay beside the finishing department. That bay is slated for the new dust-collection system installation later this month, so we need to figure out the plan for getting T-14 removed. I'm the one who makes the binding facilities decision on whether and how it gets removed, but I want to hear from all of you before we proceed. Let's go through the normal pre-work review process — I need input from maintenance, environmental, production planning, and permit compliance before I authorize any physical work. Who'd like to start?
